svg.title: The sum of the absolute coefficients of these three Lagrange polynomials is 4. If each nodal function has all required spatial derivatives bounded by vdm at derivative order m, (LCN2), applied to each parameter power, bounds its signed interpolation by 4p2vdm at radius p ≥1. The same identity holds after spatial differentiation: its parameter coefficients are fixed scalars. Thus this is a signed derivative bound, with no factor P t |wt|.
